statement: Yogini Dasha is a distinct, faster 36-year Vedic timing cycle, entered via the Moon's birth nakshatra — read alongside Vimshottari Dasha for a second, independent timing perspective, prized for its comparative simplicity and quick applicability.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
